run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-15T01:34:35Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/checkout is explained at the checkout level: checkout's PlaceOrder handler (gRPC server span 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') returns gRPC status 13 INTERNAL with the exact status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'. Traces show that the failed POST, though worded as an 'email service' call in the message, is a client span from checkout to the shipping service's '/get-quote' endpoint, which answers HTTP 400 in 30-469 microseconds without ever calling the quote service (no 'POST quote' span, no quote-service span). In the failing traces the enclosing 'prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart' span contains only GetCart and no per-item GetProduct/Convert work, whereas the successful comparison trace contains those spans and then completes /get-quote -> shipping 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote'. The most supported explanation is therefore that a fraction of checkout requests present a quote request with no items (empty cart state), and shipping rejects it with 400, which checkout surfaces as INTERNAL and the frontend/proxy render as HTTP 500. The checkout error share of PlaceOrder spans rose from 0.04 (01:35:00) to a 0.443 peak (01:49:00) and was still 0.262 at 02:13:00, so the alert condition persists. What remains unresolved is why those carts are empty: cart request/response payloads are not observable, cart itself shows no errors and answered the failing GetCart with gRPC status 0 for a real user id. Payment, quote, cart, email, currency and product-catalog showed no ERROR-status spans; pods are all Running with zero restarts and no OOM/eviction events. Note that trace-metric history in this Prometheus begins at ~01:34:35, so no pre-alert baseline exists, and the alert's own rule expression is not loaded in Prometheus, so the reported 0.2 at 01:34:35 could not be reproduced exactly.

claims.text: checkout's ERROR-status spans in this window are only two: its PlaceOrder server span 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and its client span 'HTTP POST'; both 15-minute increase series have identical values (4.4 at 01:35:00, 469.7 at 01:51:00, 198.2 near 02:14:00), i.e. two error spans per failed order.
checkout's ERROR-span 15-minute increase was 0 at 01:34:35, rose to 858.98 by 01:49:15 and eased to 353.02 by 02:13:55, so checkout spans were erroring throughout the second half of the window.

The ERROR share of checkout's PlaceOrder spans over 5-minute windows was 0.04 at 01:35:00, peaked at 0.443 at 01:49:00, fell to 0.137 at 02:05:00 and was 0.262 at 02:13:00; the corresponding UNSET share moved inversely (0.96 -> 0.557 -> 0.863 -> 0.738).

Every checkout error span in the sampled error traces from 01:38:21 to 01:39:14 (15 traces, read in a 20-row slice) carries the same diagnostic, 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' (otel.status_description and exception.message), with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13.

Whole trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231: load-generator POST (http.status_code 500) -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (500) -> frontend 'POST /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (500 / grpc 13, message '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400') -> checkout PlaceOrder (error, grpc 13) -> checkout 'HTTP POST' 826 us (error) -> shipping '/get-quote' 469 us; the failed POST's visible callee is the shipping service.

Whole trace 56478f1edaea2706c0aa93157d527c0f shows the quote request rejected in 30 microseconds: checkout 'prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart' (47.2 ms) contains only 'oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' (46.5 ms, grpc status 0; cart server span 45.9 ms with HGET 45.6 ms) followed by the erroring 'HTTP POST' (424 us) whose child is shipping '/get-quote' (30 us); there is no shipping 'POST quote' span and no quote-service span in the trace.

Whole trace 03463095c70f822db5e7f6c234f10d36 (successful end-to-end HTTP 200) shows the same path completing: prepareOrderItems contains oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (502 us) and two oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert spans, then 'HTTP POST' 18.2 ms -> shipping '/get-quote' 17.75 ms -> shipping 'POST quote' 17.6 ms -> quote 'POST /getquote' 316 us, followed by PaymentService/Charge (grpc 0), shipping '/ship-order', CartService/EmptyCart and email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' with http.status_code 200.

In the 15-minute step ending 01:49:00 shipping recorded 1227.9 '/get-quote' spans but only 829.7 'POST quote' spans, i.e. roughly 400 quote requests were served by /get-quote without any corresponding quote-service call in that window, matching the ~430 failed PlaceOrders implied by 858.98 checkout error spans.

No ERROR-status spans were recorded for shipping, quote, cart, currency, product-catalog or email anywhere in 01:20-02:14; the services with non-zero error spans besides checkout were frontend (719.8-1781.4 per 15m) and frontend-proxy, plus near-noise counts for ad (~1-2), fraud-detection (~1-2) and recommendation (~1-2); payment and accounting were exactly 0.

shipping's own logs between 01:39:05 and 01:39:20 show repeated successful quote handling ('Requesting quote' -> 'Sending Quote' -> 'Tracking ID Created' at 01:39:07.173, 01:39:11.889, 01:39:12.122, 01:39:14.353, 01:39:14.889, 01:39:18.385, 01:39:18.673) and no error text; the quote service logged 'Calculated quote' continuously in the same period.

For the failing GetCart of trace 56478f1e (checkout client start 01:38:38.1388), the cart service logged 'GetCartAsync called with userId=8dfaae44-d9db-11f0-b989-8ee5f061ab01' at 01:38:38.1387 with a non-empty user id, and the HGET completed without error.

The cart service also logged several GetCartAsync calls with a blank user id in the same minutes ('GetCartAsync called with userId=' at 01:38:41.562, 01:38:42.669 twice, 01:38:43.162/43.166, and 01:39:21.785), so some cart lookups are issued without a user id.

checkout was still completing successful orders late in the window: its logs from 02:09:11 to 02:09:31 contain 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to ...' and 'sending to postProcessor' lines.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with restartCount 0, no waiting reason and no lastState.terminated (no OOMKilled/Evicted marker); pod start times are 01:24:26-01:26:17, except load-generator at 01:58:41.

The only Kubernetes events inside the window are the load-generator rollout at 01:58:41-01:58:42: SuccessfulCreate of load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z and SuccessfulDelete of load-generator-c7cbc4c99-xlnk2 by the load-generator deployment (Scaled up 0->1 / Scaled down 1->0), with Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started; there are no eviction, OOM or probe-failure events.

ReplicaSet inventory: every otel-demo workload's active ReplicaSet was created 01:24:26-01:24:28 using the same demo 2.1.3 images (checkout-5dccddf8bb = demo:2.1.3-checkout, shipping-75d58f5d84 = demo:2.1.3-shipping, cart-755465879b, quote-6b5877698d, valkey-cart 8.1.3-alpine), with additionally flagd-7ccc846958 created 01:26:17 and load-generator-7d5756fbd9 created 01:58:41.

flagd's demo.flagd.json has every failure flag at defaultVariant 'off' (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure), with only loadGeneratorFloodHomepage defaulting to the value 100.

The traces_span_metrics_calls_total data used here begins at the alert time: a query whose lookback started 01:20:00 returned its first point at 01:35:00 with lookback_start_at 01:34:35 (source_start_at 01:35:00), so the returned series carry no sample before ~01:34:35.

shipping's '/get-quote' rejects checkout's quote request with HTTP 400 because the request carries an empty item list, and checkout converts that HTTP 400 into gRPC 13 INTERNAL. Support: the rejection completes in 30-469 us with no quote-service call, and the failing traces contain no per-item GetProduct/Convert spans inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart while the successful trace does contain them. Not verified because request/response bodies are not observable.

The empty cart state originates on the caller side (cart not populated, or already emptied, before the checkout that reaches shipping) rather than from a cart-service read failure: for the inspected failing request the cart service answered GetCart with gRPC status 0 and logged the call with a real user id, HGET completed, and cart emitted no error spans; the cart payload itself could not be observed, so this stays a hypothesis.

A load/concurrency-dependent race in cart/checkout state is more consistent with the data than a fixed validation bug, because the failure share moves with traffic (0.04 at 01:35:00, 0.443 at 01:49:00, 0.137 at 02:05:00, 0.262 at 02:13:00) while the same 2.1.3 checkout/shipping/quote images also serve successful orders; this is correlation only and is not proven.

Payment failure is not the cause: payment recorded zero ERROR-status spans in every 15-minute window examined, and the successful trace shows oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

The quote service is not the failing dependency: it had no ERROR spans, logged 'Calculated quote' continuously, and the failing traces never reach it (no /getquote span), while the successful trace does reach it via shipping 'POST quote'.

shipping saturation/timeouts are not the cause of the rejections: the observed failures are HTTP 400 answers completed in 30-469 us (not 5xx or timeouts), and ~830 of ~1228 /get-quote requests in the same 15-minute step completed a quote call with no shipping ERROR spans.

Pod crash, OOM or node-level resource failure is not the cause: all otel-demo pods are Running with restartCount 0, no termination reasons, and the only events in the window are the load-generator's own SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete rollout at 01:58:41-42.

The error string names 'email service', but the span graph places the failed POST on shipping's '/get-quote'; email is observed healthy in the same period (POST /send_order_confirmation http.status_code 200 in the successful trace, no email ERROR spans), so the message wording does not identify the failing callee.

The stack was (re)created at 01:24:26, about 10 minutes before the alert, but that rollout is not shown to be causal: the same 2.1.3 checkout, shipping and quote images serve successful orders, and no object state ties the deployment to the 400 responses; the change history integration is not available to check what changed at 01:34.

gaps: Request/response bodies are not observable: the cart contents returned to checkout and the body checkout sent to shipping's /get-quote are unknown, so 'empty item list' cannot be confirmed and the empty-cart hypothesis remains unproven.

No traces_span_metrics_calls_total samples exist before ~01:34:35 in this Prometheus, so there is no pre-alert baseline and it cannot be established when the checkout error condition actually began or how it compares with normal operation.

The alert rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not present in the loaded Prometheus rules (the rule lookup returned no data), so its exact expression, window and the reported value 0.2 at 01:34:35 could not be independently reproduced; the earliest available error-share point is 0.04 at 01:35:00.

Jaeger retained only traces from about 01:38:21 to 01:39:25 for checkout (5000-trace in-memory limit); searches in 01:40-01:55 and 02:10-02:14 returned no data, so all span-level findings come from a short, biased sample and later failures were only measured through metrics.
The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so configuration, image or feature-flag changes between 01:24 and 01:40 cannot be checked.

flagd's runtime flag state during the incident is unknown: the ConfigMap shows default variants, but overrides applied through the flagd service would not be visible, and flagd logs were empty for 01:24-01:45.

checkout's container logs contain no error-level text at all (its 01:30-02:14 output is informational lines such as 'payment went through' and 'sending to postProcessor'), and the email pod returned no log lines for 01:34-01:45, so application-log forensics for the failing path is limited.

The gRPC/HTTP status-breakdown metrics named in the tool registry (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count) returned no data in this target, so per-status request rates could not be cross-checked from those series.
The root cause of the empty cart state (caller flow, cart TTL/eviction, concurrent EmptyCart) is unresolved; cart key contents in valkey-cart could not be read.

The load-generator was rolled out at 01:58:41 (SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete), a change inside the window that I could not place as affected or as changed for another reason; the error share declined after 02:01 but not to zero, and no evidence ties the two together.
next_steps: Capture cart contents and checkout->shipping request bodies for failing PlaceOrder calls (e.g. temporary request logging or valkey key inspection for the affected user ids) to confirm whether the quote request is empty and why.
Review the shipping service's /get-quote request validation (source or configuration) to confirm which invalid request yields HTTP 400 before the quote-service call.
Inspect the load-generator checkout flow and its 01:58:41 rollout, and compare the failed-order share immediately before and after that rollout.
Check whether any flagd flag override (audit log, flagd history) or config change occurred between 01:24 and 01:40, since the change-history integration is unavailable here.
Retrieve the actual RequestErrorRate alert rule definition from Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration, because the rule is not loaded in the Prometheus queried here.

If the error share matters operationally, add baseline comparison over a period before 01:34:35 once longer retention of traces_span_metrics_calls_total is available, since no baseline exists in the current data.
